title: Conformally Certified Oriented Bounding-Box Annotation from Automatic Proposals: code and processed data
description: Python code and processed data that reproduce every table and figure of the manuscript Conformally Certified Oriented Bounding-Box Annotation from Automatic Proposals. The scripts compute proportional conformal margins for oriented proposal rectangles on the DOTA v1.0 validation images with iSAID outlines as reference shapes, together with the geometric checks, the risk-control and statistical-sandwich analyses, and the additional analyses of the revised manuscript. The archive data/obb_certified_data.zip contains the detections, reference hulls, matches, scores, splits, outputs and reference logs, released under CC BY-NC 4.0; the code is released under the MIT License.
